script:
#!/bin/bash
# 同步「噩梦模组 → “噩梦”模组」的两处文案到 VPS（走 API raw，避开 CDN 旧缓存）
set -u
API="https://api.github.com/repos/mo-xing-alt/xinmo-site/contents"
D="/var/www/xinmo-site"
fail=0

pull() {
  rel="$1"; expect="$2"
  tmp="/tmp/_sync_$(echo "$rel" | tr '/' '_')"
  curl -fsSL -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.raw" \
       -H "X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2022-11-28" \
       -H "User-Agent: xinmo-vps-sync" \
       "$API/$rel?ref=main" -o "$tmp" || { echo "下载失败: $rel"; fail=1; return; }
  size=$(stat -c %s "$tmp")
  if [ "$size" != "$expect" ]; then
    echo "字节不符: $rel 得到 $size 期望 $expect"; fail=1; return
  fi
  sudo install -m 644 -o root -g root "$tmp" "$D/$rel" && echo "已更新: $rel ($size 字节)"
}

pull "tools/etbn-mod/index.html" 18493
pull "assets/js/resources.js" 12096

echo "---- 校验关键文案 ----"
grep -c '“噩梦”模组' "$D/tools/etbn-mod/index.html" || true
grep -c '“噩梦”模组' "$D/assets/js/resources.js" || true
echo "---- 站外自检 ----"
curl -fsS "https://xinmo.work/tools/etbn-mod/index.html?t=$(date +%s)" | grep -o '“噩梦”模组' | head -1
curl -fsS "https://xinmo.work/assets/js/resources.js?t=$(date +%s)" | grep -o '“噩梦”模组' | head -1
exit $fail
